notes.en: Trackhop 2.2.6. Navidrome and Subsonic: "Keep the source order" now works there too. Songs found on a later run no longer stay at the end of the playlist: Trackhop puts the playlist back in the source's order. Thanks to raykai (#96).
notes.it: Trackhop 2.2.6. Navidrome e Subsonic: ora anche lì funziona "Mantieni l'ordine dell'origine". I brani trovati in un giro successivo non restano più in fondo alla playlist: Trackhop la rimette nell'ordine dell'origine. Grazie a raykai (#96).
notes.es: Trackhop 2.2.6. Navidrome y Subsonic: "Mantener el orden del origen" ahora también funciona ahí. Las canciones encontradas en una ejecución posterior ya no se quedan al final de la lista: Trackhop la vuelve a poner en el orden del origen. Gracias a raykai (#96).
notes.pt: Trackhop 2.2.6. Navidrome e Subsonic: "Manter a ordem da origem" agora funciona lá também. Músicas encontradas numa execução seguinte não ficam mais no fim da playlist: o Trackhop a coloca de volta na ordem da origem. Obrigado, raykai (#96).
notes.fr: Trackhop 2.2.6. Navidrome et Subsonic : « Garder l'ordre de la source » fonctionne maintenant aussi. Les titres trouvés lors d'une exécution suivante ne restent plus en fin de playlist : Trackhop la remet dans l'ordre de la source. Merci à raykai (#96).
notes.de: Trackhop 2.2.6. Navidrome und Subsonic: "Reihenfolge der Quelle beibehalten" funktioniert jetzt auch dort. Songs, die bei einem späteren Lauf gefunden werden, bleiben nicht mehr am Ende der Playlist: Trackhop bringt sie in die Reihenfolge der Quelle. Danke an raykai (#96).
notes.pl: Trackhop 2.2.6. Navidrome i Subsonic: „Zachowaj kolejność źródła” działa teraz także tam. Utwory znalezione przy kolejnym uruchomieniu nie zostają już na końcu playlisty: Trackhop układa ją w kolejności źródła. Dzięki, raykai (#96).
notes.ru: Trackhop 2.2.6. Navidrome и Subsonic: «Сохранять порядок источника» теперь работает и там. Песни, найденные при следующем запуске, больше не остаются в конце плейлиста: Trackhop возвращает порядок источника. Спасибо raykai (#96).
notes.tr: Trackhop 2.2.6. Navidrome ve Subsonic: "Kaynak sırasını koru" artık orada da çalışıyor. Sonraki bir çalıştırmada bulunan şarkılar artık listenin sonunda kalmıyor: Trackhop listeyi kaynağın sırasına geri koyuyor. Teşekkürler raykai (#96).
notes.ja: Trackhop 2.2.6。Navidrome と Subsonic：「元の順序を保つ」が使えるようになりました。後の同期で見つかった曲がプレイリストの最後に残らず、Trackhop が元の順序に並べ直します。raykai さんに感謝（#96）。
notes.ko: Trackhop 2.2.6. Navidrome, Subsonic: 이제 '원본 순서 유지'가 여기서도 작동합니다. 나중 실행에서 찾은 곡이 더 이상 재생목록 끝에 남지 않고, Trackhop이 원본 순서대로 다시 정렬합니다. raykai 님 감사합니다(#96).
notes.zh: Trackhop 2.2.6。Navidrome 和 Subsonic：“保持来源的顺序”现在也可以使用了。之后运行时找到的歌曲不再留在播放列表末尾：Trackhop 会按来源的顺序重新排列。感谢 raykai（#96）。

notes.en: Trackhop 2.2.5. Navidrome, Subsonic, Jellyfin and Plex: after a library was scanned again or re-imported, its songs get new ids and syncs filled playlists with entries that played nothing. Trackhop now checks the songs it remembers, searches again the ones that changed and repairs those playlists. New: forget every saved match to one service at once (Saved matches). Thanks to raykai (#95).
notes.it: Trackhop 2.2.5. Navidrome, Subsonic, Jellyfin e Plex: dopo una nuova scansione o importazione della libreria i brani cambiano id e le sync riempivano le playlist di voci che non suonavano niente. Ora Trackhop controlla i brani che ricorda, ricerca quelli cambiati e ripara quelle playlist. Nuovo: dimentica in un colpo tutti gli abbinamenti salvati di un servizio (Abbinamenti salvati). Grazie a raykai (#95).
notes.es: Trackhop 2.2.5. Navidrome, Subsonic, Jellyfin y Plex: tras volver a escanear o importar la biblioteca, las canciones cambian de id y las sincronizaciones llenaban las listas de entradas que no sonaban. Ahora Trackhop comprueba las canciones que recuerda, vuelve a buscar las que cambiaron y repara esas listas. Nuevo: olvidar de una vez todas las coincidencias guardadas de un servicio. Gracias a raykai (#95).
notes.pt: Trackhop 2.2.5. Navidrome, Subsonic, Jellyfin e Plex: depois de escanear ou importar a biblioteca de novo, as músicas mudam de id e as sincronizações enchiam as playlists de entradas que não tocavam nada. Agora o Trackhop verifica as músicas que lembra, busca de novo as que mudaram e conserta essas playlists. Novo: esquecer de uma vez todas as correspondências de um serviço. Obrigado, raykai (#95).
notes.fr: Trackhop 2.2.5. Navidrome, Subsonic, Jellyfin et Plex : après un nouveau scan ou import de la bibliothèque, les titres changent d'id et les synchros remplissaient les playlists d'entrées qui ne jouaient rien. Trackhop vérifie maintenant les titres mémorisés, recherche ceux qui ont changé et répare ces playlists. Nouveau : oublier d'un coup toutes les correspondances d'un service. Merci à raykai (#95).
notes.de: Trackhop 2.2.5. Navidrome, Subsonic, Jellyfin und Plex: Nach einem neuen Scan oder Import der Bibliothek bekommen die Songs neue IDs, und Syncs füllten Playlists mit Einträgen, die nichts abspielten. Trackhop prüft jetzt die gemerkten Songs, sucht geänderte neu und repariert diese Playlists. Neu: alle gespeicherten Zuordnungen zu einem Dienst auf einmal vergessen. Danke an raykai (#95).
notes.pl: Trackhop 2.2.5. Navidrome, Subsonic, Jellyfin i Plex: po ponownym skanowaniu lub imporcie biblioteki utwory dostają nowe id, a synchronizacje wypełniały playlisty wpisami, które nic nie odtwarzały. Teraz Trackhop sprawdza zapamiętane utwory, wyszukuje ponownie zmienione i naprawia te playlisty. Nowość: zapomnij naraz wszystkie zapisane dopasowania do jednej usługi. Dzięki, raykai (#95).
notes.ru: Trackhop 2.2.5. Navidrome, Subsonic, Jellyfin и Plex: после повторного сканирования или импорта библиотеки у песен меняются id, и синхронизации заполняли плейлисты записями, которые ничего не играли. Теперь Trackhop проверяет запомненные песни, заново ищет изменившиеся и чинит эти плейлисты. Новое: забыть сразу все сохранённые совпадения для одного сервиса. Спасибо raykai (#95).
notes.tr: Trackhop 2.2.5. Navidrome, Subsonic, Jellyfin ve Plex: kütüphane yeniden tarandığında veya içe aktarıldığında şarkıların kimlikleri değişiyor ve eşitlemeler çalma listelerini hiçbir şey çalmayan girişlerle dolduruyordu. Trackhop artık hatırladığı şarkıları kontrol ediyor, değişenleri yeniden arıyor ve bu listeleri onarıyor. Yeni: bir hizmetin tüm kayıtlı eşleşmelerini tek seferde unut. Teşekkürler raykai (#95).
notes.ja: Trackhop 2.2.5。Navidrome、Subsonic、Jellyfin、Plex：ライブラリを再スキャン・再インポートすると曲の ID が変わり、同期で何も再生されない項目がプレイリストに入っていました。Trackhop は記憶している曲を確認し、変わった曲を検索し直して、そのプレイリストを修復するようになりました。新機能：1つのサービスへの保存済みの一致をまとめて削除。raykai さんに感謝（#95）。
notes.ko: Trackhop 2.2.5. Navidrome, Subsonic, Jellyfin, Plex: 라이브러리를 다시 스캔하거나 가져오면 곡 ID가 바뀌어 동기화가 아무것도 재생되지 않는 항목으로 재생목록을 채웠습니다. 이제 Trackhop이 기억한 곡을 확인하고 바뀐 곡을 다시 검색해 그 재생목록을 고칩니다. 새 기능: 한 서비스의 저장된 일치를 한 번에 지우기. raykai 님 감사합니다(#95).
notes.zh: Trackhop 2.2.5。Navidrome、Subsonic、Jellyfin 和 Plex：重新扫描或重新导入音乐库后，歌曲的 ID 会改变，同步会在播放列表里加入无法播放的条目。现在 Trackhop 会检查记住的歌曲，重新搜索已改变的歌曲并修复这些播放列表。新功能：一次忘记某个服务的所有已保存匹配。感谢 raykai（#95）。

notes.en: Trackhop 2.2.4. Amazon Music: signing in again closed too early, on music.amazon.com instead of the account's own site (music.amazon.it, .de…), and syncs then failed with "session expired". The sign-in now waits for the signed-in player and moves on to the account's site. If Amazon Music asks you to sign in, sign in once more.
notes.it: Trackhop 2.2.4. Amazon Music: riaccedendo, l'accesso si chiudeva troppo presto su music.amazon.com invece che sul sito dell'account (music.amazon.it, .de…) e le sync fallivano con "sessione scaduta". Ora l'accesso aspetta il player collegato e passa al sito dell'account. Se Amazon Music ti chiede di accedere, accedi ancora una volta.
notes.es: Trackhop 2.2.4. Amazon Music: al volver a iniciar sesión, se cerraba demasiado pronto en music.amazon.com en lugar del sitio de la cuenta (music.amazon.es, .it…) y las sincronizaciones fallaban con "sesión caducada". Ahora espera al reproductor con la sesión iniciada y pasa al sitio de la cuenta. Si Amazon Music te pide iniciar sesión, hazlo una vez más.
notes.pt: Trackhop 2.2.4. Amazon Music: ao entrar de novo, o login fechava cedo demais em music.amazon.com em vez do site da conta (music.amazon.com.br, .it…) e as sincronizações falhavam com "sessão expirada". Agora o login espera o player conectado e passa para o site da conta. Se o Amazon Music pedir login, entre mais uma vez.
notes.fr: Trackhop 2.2.4. Amazon Music : la reconnexion se fermait trop tôt, sur music.amazon.com au lieu du site du compte (music.amazon.fr, .it…), et les synchros échouaient ensuite avec « session expirée ». La connexion attend désormais le lecteur connecté et passe au site du compte. Si Amazon Music vous demande de vous connecter, reconnectez-vous une fois.
notes.de: Trackhop 2.2.4. Amazon Music: Die erneute Anmeldung schloss zu früh, auf music.amazon.com statt auf der Seite des Kontos (music.amazon.de, .it…), und Syncs schlugen dann mit "Sitzung abgelaufen" fehl. Die Anmeldung wartet jetzt auf den angemeldeten Player und wechselt zur Seite des Kontos. Fragt Amazon Music nach einer Anmeldung, melde dich noch einmal an.
notes.pl: Trackhop 2.2.4. Amazon Music: ponowne logowanie zamykało się za wcześnie, na music.amazon.com zamiast na stronie konta (music.amazon.de, .it…), a synchronizacje kończyły się błędem "sesja wygasła". Logowanie czeka teraz na zalogowany odtwarzacz i przechodzi na stronę konta. Jeśli Amazon Music poprosi o zalogowanie, zaloguj się jeszcze raz.
notes.ru: Trackhop 2.2.4. Amazon Music: повторный вход закрывался слишком рано, на music.amazon.com вместо сайта аккаунта (music.amazon.de, .it…), и синхронизации затем падали с ошибкой «сессия истекла». Теперь вход ждёт плеер с выполненным входом и переходит на сайт аккаунта. Если Amazon Music просит войти, войдите ещё раз.
notes.tr: Trackhop 2.2.4. Amazon Music: yeniden giriş, hesabın kendi sitesi (music.amazon.com.tr, .it…) yerine music.amazon.com'da çok erken kapanıyordu ve eşitlemeler "oturum süresi doldu" hatasıyla başarısız oluyordu. Giriş artık oturum açmış oynatıcıyı bekliyor ve hesabın sitesine geçiyor. Amazon Music giriş isterse bir kez daha giriş yap.
notes.ja: Trackhop 2.2.4。Amazon Music：再ログインがアカウントのサイト（music.amazon.co.jp、.it…）ではなく music.amazon.com で早く閉じてしまい、同期が「セッション切れ」で失敗していました。ログインはサインイン済みのプレーヤーを待ってからアカウントのサイトへ移るようになりました。Amazon Music からログインを求められたら、もう一度ログインしてください。
notes.ko: Trackhop 2.2.4. Amazon Music: 다시 로그인할 때 계정 사이트(music.amazon.de, .it…) 대신 music.amazon.com에서 너무 일찍 닫혀 동기화가 "세션 만료"로 실패했습니다. 이제 로그인된 플레이어를 기다린 뒤 계정 사이트로 이동합니다. Amazon Music이 로그인을 요청하면 한 번 더 로그인하세요.
notes.zh: Trackhop 2.2.4。Amazon Music：重新登录时会过早地在 music.amazon.com 关闭，而不是账号自己的站点（music.amazon.de、.it…），之后同步会因“会话已过期”而失败。现在登录会等待已登录的播放器，并转到账号的站点。如果 Amazon Music 要求登录，请再登录一次。

notes.en: Trackhop 2.2.3. Signed-in services stay signed in: sessions are renewed twice a day, so you sign in again only when a service really ends one. New: Reconnect in each account's menu in Accounts. Fixed: TIDAL and others could sign out on their own during parallel syncs. Deezer Liked songs synced to another service's Liked songs keep their order: the newest like ends on top. Amazon Music: signing in again keeps the account's regional site. Thanks to @Doggo785 (#87).
notes.it: Trackhop 2.2.3. I servizi restano collegati: le sessioni si rinnovano due volte al giorno e riaccedi solo se un servizio le chiude davvero. Nuovo: Ricollega nel menu di ogni account in Account. Corretto: TIDAL e altri potevano scollegarsi da soli con più sync insieme. I Brani preferiti di Deezer copiati nei preferiti di un altro servizio tengono l'ordine: l'ultimo resta in cima. Amazon Music: riaccedendo resta il sito regionale dell'account. Grazie a @Doggo785 (#87).
notes.es: Trackhop 2.2.3. Los servicios siguen conectados solos: las sesiones se renuevan dos veces al día y solo vuelves a entrar si un servicio las cierra. Nuevo: Reconectar en el menú de cada cuenta (Cuentas). Corregido: TIDAL y otras podían desconectarse solas con sincronizaciones en paralelo. Las Canciones que te gustan de Deezer copiadas a las de otro servicio mantienen el orden: la última arriba. Amazon Music: al volver a entrar se mantiene el sitio regional. Gracias a @Doggo785 (#87).
notes.pt: Trackhop 2.2.3. Os serviços continuam conectados: as sessões são renovadas duas vezes por dia e você só entra de novo se um serviço as encerrar. Novo: Reconectar no menu de cada conta (Contas). Corrigido: TIDAL e outros podiam sair sozinhos com sincronizações em paralelo. Músicas curtidas do Deezer copiadas para as de outro serviço mantêm a ordem: a mais recente no topo. Amazon Music: entrar de novo mantém o site regional da conta. Obrigado a @Doggo785 (#87).
notes.fr: Trackhop 2.2.3. Les services restent connectés : les sessions sont renouvelées deux fois par jour, reconnexion seulement si un service les ferme. Nouveau : Reconnecter dans le menu de chaque compte (Comptes). Corrigé : TIDAL et d'autres se déconnectaient seuls avec des synchros en parallèle. Les Titres likés Deezer copiés vers ceux d'un autre service gardent l'ordre : le dernier en haut. Amazon Music : reconnexion sur le site régional du compte. Merci à @Doggo785 (#87).
notes.de: Trackhop 2.2.3. Angemeldete Dienste bleiben von selbst angemeldet: Jede Kontositzung wird zweimal täglich erneuert, neu anmelden musst du dich nur, wenn ein Dienst sie wirklich beendet hat. Neu: Neu verbinden im Kontomenü (Konten). Behoben: TIDAL u. a. meldeten sich bei parallelen Syncs selbst ab. Deezer-Lieblingssongs in Lieblingssongs anderer Dienste behalten die Reihenfolge: der neueste oben. Amazon Music: Neue Anmeldung bleibt auf der Regionalseite. Danke an @Doggo785 (#87).
notes.pl: Trackhop 2.2.3. Serwisy same pozostają zalogowane: sesje są odnawiane dwa razy dziennie, a logujesz się ponownie tylko, gdy serwis je zakończy. Nowość: Połącz ponownie w menu konta (Konta). Poprawka: TIDAL i inne mogły same się wylogować przy równoległych synchronizacjach. Polubione utwory z Deezera kopiowane do polubionych innego serwisu zachowują kolejność: najnowszy na górze. Amazon Music: ponowne logowanie zostaje na stronie regionu konta. Dzięki @Doggo785 (#87).
notes.ru: Trackhop 2.2.3. Сервисы остаются подключёнными сами: сессии обновляются дважды в день, и войти снова нужно, только если сервис их завершил. Новое: «Переподключить» в меню аккаунта («Аккаунты»). Исправлено: TIDAL и другие могли сами выходить при параллельных синхронизациях. Любимые треки Deezer, скопированные в любимые другого сервиса, сохраняют порядок: новый сверху. Amazon Music: повторный вход остаётся на региональном сайте. Спасибо @Doggo785 (#87).
notes.tr: Trackhop 2.2.3. Servisler bağlı kalır: oturumlar günde iki kez yenilenir, yeniden giriş yalnızca servis oturumu kapattığında gerekir. Yeni: Hesaplar'da her hesabın menüsünde Yeniden bağlan. Düzeltildi: TIDAL ve diğerleri paralel eşitlemelerde kendiliğinden çıkış yapabiliyordu. Deezer'daki Beğenilen şarkılar başka bir servisinkilere sırasıyla aktarılır: en yenisi en üstte. Amazon Music: yeniden giriş hesabın bölge sitesinde kalır. Teşekkürler @Doggo785 (#87).
notes.ja: Trackhop 2.2.3。ログイン中のサービスは自動でログインを維持します。1日2回、各アカウントのセッションを更新するため、サービスが本当に終了した場合にだけ再ログインをお願いします。新機能：「アカウント」で各アカウントのメニューに「再接続」。修正：複数の同期を同時に実行すると TIDAL などが勝手にログアウトすることがありました。 Deezer の「お気に入りの曲」を他のサービスの「お気に入りの曲」に同期しても順番を保ちます（最新が一番上）。 Amazon Music：再ログイン時もアカウントの地域サイトを維持します。 @Doggo785 さん、ありがとうございます（#87）。
notes.ko: Trackhop 2.2.3. 로그인된 서비스가 스스로 로그인 상태를 유지합니다. 하루 두 번 각 계정의 세션을 갱신하므로 서비스가 실제로 세션을 끝냈을 때만 다시 로그인하라고 요청합니다. 새 기능: 계정에서 각 계정 메뉴의 다시 연결. 수정: 여러 동기화를 동시에 실행하면 TIDAL 등이 저절로 로그아웃될 수 있었습니다. Deezer의 좋아요 표시한 곡을 다른 서비스의 좋아요 표시한 곡으로 동기화해도 순서가 유지됩니다(최신 곡이 맨 위). Amazon Music: 다시 로그인해도 계정의 지역 사이트를 유지합니다. @Doggo785 님께 감사드립니다(#87).
notes.zh: Trackhop 2.2.3。已登录的服务会自动保持登录：每天两次续期每个账号的会话，只有当服务真正结束会话时才会请你重新登录。新增：在“账号”中每个账号的菜单里加入“重新连接”。修复：同时运行多个同步时，TIDAL 等登录可能会自行退出。 将 Deezer 的“喜欢的歌曲”同步到其他服务的“喜欢的歌曲”时会保持顺序：最新喜欢的排在最上面。 Amazon Music：重新登录会保留账号所属的地区网站。 感谢 @Doggo785（#87）。

notes.en:
Released with the app's 2.2.6.

- **Fixed**: on Navidrome and Subsonic, songs found on a later run stayed at the end of the playlist. "Keep the source's order" now works there too: the Subsonic API has no move, so Trackhop writes the playlist back whole in the source's order. Thanks to raykai (#96).

Released with the app's 2.2.5.

- **Fixed**: after a Navidrome, Subsonic, Jellyfin or Plex library was scanned again or re-imported, its songs got new ids and syncs kept adding the old ones, so playlists filled with entries that played nothing. Trackhop now checks the songs it remembers on these servers, searches again the ones that changed and repairs the playlists it wrote. Thanks to raykai (#95).
- **Forget every saved match to a service** at once: on Tools › Saved matches (with "To:" set) and on the service's page; also `DELETE /api/v1/matches?to=<service>`.

Released on its own (the app stays at 2.2.4).

- **Fixed**: Files › "Try the patterns" answered "Too large: files up to 20 MB" when a big file (an Apple Music/iTunes library) was already chosen for upload: the button sent the file too. It now sends only the patterns and the line to try. Thanks to raykai (#91).

Released with the app's 2.2.3.

- **Signed-in services stay signed in on their own**: twice a day the server renews the session of each signed-in account (the official sign-ins and the web connectors it runs), one after the other, with one line per account in the log. You are asked to sign in again (on your notification channels and on the Notifications page) only when a service really ended a session.
- **Reconnect**: a button on each service's page renews its session now; when that cannot work, the account is signed out and its sign-in opens. Also `POST /api/v1/services/{id}/reconnect` and `trackhop reconnect <service>`.
- **Fixed**: TIDAL and other official sign-ins could sign out by themselves when several syncs renewed the same access at once; renewals now go one at a time per account.
- **Fixed**: Deezer liked songs synced to another service's liked songs keep their order: the newest like ends on top. Thanks to @Doggo785 (#87).
Trackhop 2.2.2. Import file and Paste a list on the File card in Accounts work again: both open File playlists in Tools and import there, the same way as from Tools.
notes.it: Trackhop 2.2.2. Importa file e Incolla un elenco nella scheda File di Account funzionano di nuovo: aprono Playlist File in Strumenti e importano lì, come da Strumenti.
notes.es: Trackhop 2.2.2. Importar archivo y Pegar una lista en la tarjeta Archivo de Cuentas vuelven a funcionar: ambos abren Listas de archivo en Herramientas e importan allí, como desde Herramientas.

notes.en:
Released with the app's 2.2.1.

- **Songs not found, for every service**: Tools › Songs not found lists what your syncs could not find on any service, not only on your own server; export it (CSV, M3U, text, JSON, Lidarr list) or save it as a File playlist to sync anywhere. Also `GET /api/v1/wanted?scope=all&on=<service>`, `POST /api/v1/wanted/file-playlist` and `trackhop wanted --everywhere [--missing-on <service>] [--save-as <name>]`. Missing on my server and the Lidarr link are unchanged.

Released with the app's 2.2.

- **Almost everything the app does**: review before adding, To fix, saved schedules, preview, covers, stats, the concert diary, shared playlists, the playlist roast, the YouTube quota and more now have their pages, with the REST API and the command line where it fits.
- **Several syncs at once**: run a group of syncs together from one page, the REST API (`/api/v1/multi`) or `trackhop multi`.
- **Which service?**: a chooser with search (other names work too), your own accounts first and categories.
- **Matching**: better with "feat." guests, remixes, versions ("Taylor's Version"), Deluxe and Remaster editions and names like AC/DC; traditional and simplified Chinese match each other; a source that has not changed is skipped; songs not found are searched again after a month; "Why wasn't it matched?" lists the candidates.
- **YouTube Music**: shows which profile or channel is connected, and warns if your music is on another one.
- **Deezer**: Family plans, choose the profile. The official Deezer sign-in is no longer offered to new users ("Why no Deezer?" explains).
- **ListenBrainz as a target**, **Plex** (five stars as liked songs, "Sounds like" and "Sonic adventure", copy a playlist to a Plex Home user), personal servers with a home and an away address, **Apple Music removals**, a link to a playlist file as a source, a **Soundiiz-compatible JSON** export, **Apprise** notifications, star ratings copied to Subsonic and Navidrome, and Select all / None above long lists.
- **Radio stations and Shazam as services**: each station is a service of its own on the Services page (as many as you like), Shazam one more; a sync uses them as its source, from the page, the REST API (`POST /api/v1/services/radio`, `"source": {"service": "radio@2"}`) or `trackhop services add radio` and `trackhop new radio@2 …`. Radio and Shazam syncs already here move over by themselves.
- **Notifications page**: what was sent to your notification channels, with the channels that took it and a link to the sync, its review or the page it is about (also `GET /api/v1/notifications/history` and `trackhop notifications`).
- **Linux**: the `.deb` also installs on systems without a desktop.
- **Windows**: the `.zip` runs again.

Trackhop 2.1.6. Sign-in pages opened in the app no longer stop at an error right after the email, and signing in with Facebook or Apple no longer asks for a long robot check. Song lists in Discover show every cover, not only the first ones. My records shows a record added or removed on Discogs when you come back. "Country/Region" wherever a place is picked. Small fixes.

notes.en: - **Linux `.deb` on older systems**: the `.deb` files (PC and ARM) install again on Debian 12, Raspberry Pi OS Bookworm and Ubuntu 22.04; 2.1.4's asked for a package those systems do not have.

- **Raspberry Pi and Linux on ARM**: Trackhop Desktop for 64-bit ARM, as a `.deb` and a `.tar.gz` (`-linux-arm64`), for a Raspberry Pi 4 or 5 with a 64-bit system and ARM laptops. The Docker image already ran there.

Docker fix.

- **Docker, a new data folder**: when Docker creates the data folder itself (a folder in a compose file, Unraid's appdata, a cloud volume), Trackhop can now write there; before, it could not save anything. The container starts as root only to give that folder to Trackhop's own user, then runs Trackhop as that user, never as root. New `PUID` and `PGID` pick another user, for example `99` and `100` on Unraid.
- **Render**: a "Deploy to Render" button in the README; Trackhop takes Render's address by itself.

Trackhop 2.1.4. When a service slows down adding many liked songs, Trackhop waits and goes on, and the songs it could not add yet are shown as "to add next run" instead of not found; the next run adds them. The card and the notification say so. Manage playlists now lists your liked songs too, to look through, remove songs or export. Small fixes.
notes.it: Trackhop 2.1.4. Quando un servizio rallenta l'aggiunta di tanti brani preferiti, Trackhop aspetta e continua, e i brani che non è ancora riuscito ad aggiungere compaiono come "da aggiungere al prossimo giro" invece che non trovati; il giro dopo li aggiunge. La card e la notifica lo dicono. Gestisci playlist ora mostra anche i preferiti, per sfogliarli, togliere brani o esportarli. Piccole correzioni.
notes.es: Trackhop 2.1.4. Cuando un servicio frena la adición de muchas canciones favoritas, Trackhop espera y sigue, y las canciones que aún no pudo añadir aparecen como "por añadir en la próxima ejecución" en vez de no encontradas; la siguiente las añade. La tarjeta y la notificación lo indican. Gestionar listas ahora muestra también tus favoritas, para verlas, quitar canciones o exportarlas. Pequeñas correcciones.
notes.pt: Trackhop 2.1.4. Quando um serviço freia a adição de muitas músicas curtidas, o Trackhop espera e continua, e as músicas que ainda não conseguiu adicionar aparecem como "para adicionar na próxima execução" em vez de não encontradas; a próxima as adiciona. O cartão e a notificação avisam. Gerenciar playlists agora mostra também suas curtidas, para ver, remover músicas ou exportar. Pequenas correções.
notes.fr: Trackhop 2.1.4. Quand un service ralentit l'ajout de nombreux titres aimés, Trackhop attend et continue, et les titres pas encore ajoutés apparaissent comme "à ajouter au prochain passage" au lieu d'introuvables ; le passage suivant les ajoute. La carte et la notification l'indiquent. Gérer les playlists affiche aussi tes titres aimés, pour les parcourir, retirer des titres ou les exporter. Petites corrections.
notes.de: Trackhop 2.1.4. Wenn ein Dienst das Hinzufügen vieler Lieblingssongs bremst, wartet Trackhop und macht weiter. Songs, die noch nicht hinzugefügt werden konnten, erscheinen als "beim nächsten Lauf hinzufügen" statt als nicht gefunden; der nächste Lauf fügt sie hinzu. Karte und Benachrichtigung sagen es. Playlists verwalten zeigt jetzt auch deine Lieblingssongs: ansehen, Songs entfernen oder exportieren. Kleine Korrekturen.
notes.pl: Trackhop 2.1.4. Gdy serwis spowalnia dodawanie wielu polubionych utworów, Trackhop czeka i kontynuuje, a utwory, których jeszcze nie dodał, są oznaczone jako "do dodania przy następnym uruchomieniu" zamiast nieznalezionych; następne uruchomienie je doda. Mówią o tym karta i powiadomienie. Zarządzanie playlistami pokazuje też polubione utwory: przeglądanie, usuwanie i eksport. Drobne poprawki.
notes.ru: Trackhop 2.1.4. Когда сервис ограничивает добавление большого числа любимых треков, Trackhop ждёт и продолжает, а треки, которые ещё не удалось добавить, отмечаются как "добавить при следующем запуске", а не как не найденные; следующий запуск их добавит. Об этом говорят карточка и уведомление. В управлении плейлистами теперь есть и любимые треки: просмотр, удаление и экспорт. Мелкие исправления.
notes.tr: Trackhop 2.1.4. Bir hizmet çok sayıda beğenilen şarkının eklenmesini yavaşlattığında Trackhop bekler ve devam eder; henüz eklenemeyen şarkılar bulunamadı yerine "sonraki çalıştırmada eklenecek" olarak görünür ve sonraki çalıştırma onları ekler. Kart ve bildirim bunu söyler. Çalma listelerini yönet artık beğenilen şarkıları da gösterir: göz at, şarkı çıkar veya dışa aktar. Küçük düzeltmeler.
notes.ja: Trackhop 2.1.4。サービスがお気に入りの曲の大量追加を制限したとき、Trackhopは待ってから続けます。まだ追加できなかった曲は「見つからない」ではなく「次回追加」と表示され、次回の実行で追加されます。カードと通知にも表示されます。プレイリストの管理にお気に入りの曲も表示され、閲覧、曲の削除、エクスポートができます。細かな修正。
notes.ko: Trackhop 2.1.4. 서비스가 좋아요 표시한 곡을 많이 추가하는 것을 제한하면 Trackhop은 기다렸다가 계속합니다. 아직 추가하지 못한 곡은 찾을 수 없음 대신 "다음 실행 때 추가"로 표시되고 다음 실행에서 추가됩니다. 카드와 알림에도 표시됩니다. 플레이리스트 관리에서 좋아요 표시한 곡도 보고, 곡을 빼거나 내보낼 수 있습니다. 작은 수정.
notes.zh: Trackhop 2.1.4。当某个服务限制大量添加喜欢的歌曲时，Trackhop 会等待后继续；暂时未能添加的歌曲显示为“下次运行时添加”，而不是未找到，下次运行会添加它们。卡片和通知也会说明。管理播放列表现在也会显示你喜欢的歌曲，可以浏览、移除歌曲或导出。小修复。

notes.en: Trackhop 2.1.3. A multi sync can use your liked songs as its source or a target, in the ways that lose nothing, and you choose a target's way when you add it. A two-way sync with liked songs no longer removes songs a service leaves out of its liked list. TIDAL playlists are read faster. Sync all runs each multi sync in its order. The To fix list shows a multi sync's real source. A long press on a running multi sync opens its menu. Small fixes.
notes.it: Trackhop 2.1.3. La sync multipla può usare i brani preferiti come sorgente o destinazione, nei modi che non perdono nulla, e scegli il modo di una destinazione quando la aggiungi. Una sync bidirezionale con i preferiti non toglie più i brani che un servizio non mostra nei preferiti. Le playlist di TIDAL si leggono più in fretta. Sincronizza tutto segue l'ordine delle sync multiple. La lista Da sistemare mostra la vera sorgente. Piccole correzioni.
notes.es: Trackhop 2.1.3. Una sincronización múltiple puede usar tus canciones favoritas como origen o destino, de las formas que no pierden nada, y eliges el modo de un destino al añadirlo. Una sincronización bidireccional con favoritas ya no quita canciones que un servicio no muestra. Las listas de TIDAL se leen más rápido. Sincronizar todo respeta el orden de las múltiples. La lista Por arreglar muestra el origen real. Pequeñas correcciones.
notes.pt: Trackhop 2.1.3. Uma sincronização múltipla pode usar suas músicas curtidas como origem ou destino, de jeitos que não perdem nada, e você escolhe o modo de um destino ao adicioná-lo. Uma sincronização bidirecional com curtidas não tira mais músicas que um serviço não lista. Playlists do TIDAL são lidas mais rápido. Sincronizar tudo segue a ordem das múltiplas. A lista Para corrigir mostra a origem real. Pequenas correções.
notes.fr: Trackhop 2.1.3. Une synchro multiple peut utiliser vos titres aimés comme source ou cible, de façon à ne rien perdre, et vous choisissez le mode d'une cible en l'ajoutant. Une synchro bidirectionnelle avec les titres aimés ne retire plus ceux qu'un service ne liste pas. Les playlists TIDAL se lisent plus vite. Tout synchroniser suit l'ordre des synchros multiples. La liste À corriger montre la vraie source. Petites corrections.
notes.de: Trackhop 2.1.3. Ein Multi-Sync kann deine Lieblingssongs als Quelle oder Ziel nutzen, so dass nichts verloren geht, und du wählst die Art eines Ziels beim Hinzufügen. Ein Zwei-Wege-Sync mit Lieblingssongs entfernt keine Songs mehr, die ein Dienst nicht auflistet. TIDAL-Playlists werden schneller gelesen. Alle synchronisieren hält die Reihenfolge der Multi-Syncs ein. Die Liste zum Korrigieren zeigt die echte Quelle. Kleine Korrekturen.
notes.pl: Trackhop 2.1.3. Synchronizacja z wieloma serwisami może używać polubionych utworów jako źródła lub celu, tak by nic nie zginęło, a sposób celu wybierasz przy dodawaniu. Dwukierunkowa synchronizacja z polubionymi nie usuwa już utworów, których serwis nie pokazuje. Playlisty TIDAL czytane są szybciej. Synchronizuj wszystko zachowuje kolejność. Lista do poprawy pokazuje prawdziwe źródło. Drobne poprawki.
notes.ru: Trackhop 2.1.3. Мультисинхронизация может использовать любимые треки как источник или цель так, чтобы ничего не потерять, а способ цели выбирается при добавлении. Двусторонняя синхронизация с любимыми больше не удаляет треки, которые сервис не показывает. Плейлисты TIDAL читаются быстрее. «Синхронизировать всё» соблюдает порядок мультисинхронизаций. Список «Исправить» показывает настоящий источник. Мелкие исправления.
notes.tr: Trackhop 2.1.3. Çoklu eşitleme beğenilen şarkılarınızı hiçbir şey kaybetmeden kaynak ya da hedef olarak kullanabilir; hedefin biçimini eklerken seçersiniz. Beğenilenlerle çift yönlü eşitleme, bir servisin listelemediği şarkıları artık silmiyor. TIDAL çalma listeleri daha hızlı okunuyor. Tümünü eşitle, çoklu eşitlemelerin sırasını izler. Düzeltilecekler listesi gerçek kaynağı gösterir. Küçük düzeltmeler.
notes.ja: Trackhop 2.1.3。複数同期でお気に入りの曲をソースや送り先として、何も失わない方法で使えます。送り先を追加するときに方式を選べます。お気に入りとの双方向同期は、サービスが一覧に出さない曲を削除しなくなりました。TIDALのプレイリストの読み込みが速くなりました。すべて同期は複数同期の順序を守ります。修正リストに本当のソースが表示されます。細かな修正。
notes.ko: Trackhop 2.1.3. 여러 서비스 동기화에서 좋아요 표시한 곡을 아무것도 잃지 않는 방식으로 소스나 대상으로 쓸 수 있고, 대상을 추가할 때 방식을 고릅니다. 좋아요와의 양방향 동기화는 서비스가 목록에 보여 주지 않는 곡을 더 이상 지우지 않습니다. TIDAL 플레이리스트를 더 빨리 읽습니다. 모두 동기화는 여러 서비스 동기화의 순서를 따릅니다. 수정할 목록에 실제 소스가 표시됩니다. 작은 수정.
notes.zh: Trackhop 2.1.3。多服务同步可以用你喜欢的歌曲作为源或目标，并以不丢失任何内容的方式进行；添加目标时即可选择其方式。与喜欢歌曲的双向同步不再删除服务未列出的歌曲。TIDAL 播放列表读取更快。全部同步会按多服务同步的顺序运行。待修正列表显示真正的源。小修正。

notes.en: Trackhop 2.1.2. Fixes for the multi sync. The group page's schedule has the same choices as the editor and keeps them. The card keeps its height while it runs; the large card shows the same figures and history as a classic sync. A song to check shows on the card and on its service's row. Adding a target keeps the timing and the pause. Switching to an exact copy asks first: it removes songs you added there. Sync works when paused. Preview and Edit wait while it runs. Wi-Fi only is in the editor.
notes.it: Trackhop 2.1.2. Correzioni per la sync multipla. La pianificazione nella pagina del gruppo ha le stesse scelte dell'editor e non le azzera più. La card resta alta come le altre mentre lavora; la card grande mostra dati e cronologia di una sync classica. Un brano da controllare compare sulla card e sulla riga del suo servizio. Aggiungere una destinazione mantiene orari e pausa. Passare a copia esatta chiede conferma. Sync funziona anche in pausa. Solo Wi-Fi è nell'editor.
notes.es: Trackhop 2.1.2. Correcciones para la sync múltiple. La programación de la página del grupo tiene las mismas opciones que el editor y ya no las borra. La tarjeta mantiene la altura de las demás mientras trabaja; la tarjeta grande muestra los mismos datos e historial que una sync clásica. Una canción por revisar aparece en la tarjeta y en la fila de su servicio. Añadir un destino conserva horarios y pausa. Pasar a copia exacta pregunta antes. Sync funciona en pausa. Solo Wi-Fi está en el editor.
notes.pt: Trackhop 2.1.2. Correções na sync múltipla. O agendamento na página do grupo tem as mesmas opções do editor e não as apaga mais. O card mantém a altura dos outros enquanto roda; o card grande mostra os mesmos dados e o histórico de uma sync clássica. Uma música para conferir aparece no card e na linha do serviço dela. Adicionar um destino mantém horários e pausa. Mudar para cópia exata pergunta antes. Sync funciona em pausa. Prévia e Editar esperam ela terminar. Só Wi-Fi está no editor.
notes.fr: Trackhop 2.1.2. Corrections pour la sync multiple. La planification de la page du groupe a les mêmes choix que l'éditeur et les garde. La carte garde la hauteur des autres pendant qu'elle tourne ; la grande carte montre les mêmes données et l'historique d'une sync classique. Un titre à vérifier apparaît sur la carte et sur la ligne de son service. Ajouter une cible garde les horaires et la pause. Passer en copie exacte demande d'abord. Sync marche en pause. Wi-Fi seul est dans l'éditeur.
notes.de: Trackhop 2.1.2. Korrekturen für den Multi-Sync. Der Zeitplan auf der Gruppenseite hat dieselben Optionen wie der Editor und behält sie. Die Karte bleibt beim Laufen so hoch wie die anderen; die große Karte zeigt dieselben Werte und den Verlauf wie ein klassischer Sync. Ein zu prüfender Song erscheint auf der Karte und in der Zeile seines Dienstes. Ein neues Ziel behält Zeitplan und Pause. Der Wechsel zur exakten Kopie fragt vorher nach. Sync läuft auch bei Pause. Nur WLAN steht im Editor.
notes.pl: Trackhop 2.1.2. Poprawki multi sync. Harmonogram na stronie grupy ma te same opcje co edytor i już ich nie zeruje. Karta ma podczas pracy tę samą wysokość co inne; duża karta pokazuje te same dane i historię co klasyczna sync. Utwór do sprawdzenia widać na karcie i w wierszu jego serwisu. Dodanie celu zachowuje harmonogram i pauzę. Przejście na dokładną kopię najpierw pyta: usuwa dodane tam utwory. Sync działa też przy pauzie. Podgląd i Edycja czekają, aż skończy. Tylko Wi-Fi jest w edytorze.
notes.ru: Trackhop 2.1.2. Исправления мульти-синхронизации. Расписание на странице группы имеет те же варианты, что и редактор, и больше их не сбрасывает. Карточка во время работы той же высоты, что и другие; большая карточка показывает те же данные и историю, что и обычная синхронизация. Песня для проверки видна на карточке и в строке своего сервиса. Новая цель сохраняет расписание и паузу. Переход на точную копию сначала спрашивает. Синхронизация работает и на паузе. Только Wi-Fi есть в редакторе.
notes.tr: Trackhop 2.1.2. Çoklu sync için düzeltmeler. Grup sayfasındaki zamanlama editörle aynı seçenekleri kullanır ve artık sıfırlamaz. Kart çalışırken diğerleriyle aynı yükseklikte kalır; büyük kart klasik sync ile aynı bilgileri ve geçmişi gösterir. Kontrol edilecek şarkı kartta ve servisinin satırında görünür. Hedef eklemek zamanlamayı ve duraklatmayı korur. Tam kopyaya geçiş önce sorar. Sync duraklatılmışken de çalışır. Önizleme ve Düzenle çalışma bitene kadar bekler. Yalnızca Wi-Fi editörde.
notes.ja: Trackhop 2.1.2. マルチ同期の修正です。グループページのスケジュールはエディターと同じ選択肢になり、リセットされなくなりました。実行中もカードの高さは他と同じで、大きいカードには通常の同期と同じ数値と履歴が表示されます。確認が必要な曲は、マルチ同期のカードとそのサービスの行に表示されます。グループページから追加した同期先は、時間設定と一時停止を引き継ぎます。完全コピーへの切り替えは、そこに追加した曲が削除されるため、先に確認します。サービスのメニューはエディターと同じ三つの方法です。一時停止中のマルチ同期でも「同期」が使えます。プレビューと編集は実行が終わるまで待ちます。Wi-Fiのみの設定がエディターに入りました。
notes.ko: Trackhop 2.1.2. 멀티 동기화 수정입니다. 그룹 페이지의 일정은 편집기와 같은 선택지를 쓰고 더 이상 초기화하지 않습니다. 실행 중에도 카드 높이가 다른 카드와 같고, 큰 카드는 일반 동기화와 같은 수치와 기록을 보여줍니다. 확인할 곡은 멀티 동기화 카드와 해당 서비스 행에 표시됩니다. 그룹 페이지에서 대상을 추가하면 시간 설정과 일시정지가 유지됩니다. 정확한 복사로 바꿀 때는 거기에 추가한 곡이 삭제되므로 먼저 묻습니다. 서비스 메뉴는 편집기와 같은 세 가지 방식을 씁니다. 일시정지된 멀티 동기화에서도 동기화가 작동합니다. 미리보기와 편집은 실행이 끝날 때까지 기다립니다. Wi-Fi 전용 설정이 편집기에 있습니다.
notes.zh: Trackhop 2.1.2. 多目标同步的修复。群组页面的计划使用与编辑器相同的选项，并且不再重置。运行时卡片高度与其他卡片一致，大卡片显示与普通同步相同的数据和运行记录。需要检查的歌曲会显示在多目标同步的卡片和对应服务的那一行，搜索只统计你看到的同步。从群组页面添加目标会使用新编辑器，并保留时间设置和暂停状态。切换为完全复制前会先询问，因为这会删除你在那里添加的歌曲。服务菜单使用与编辑器相同的三种方式。已暂停的多目标同步现在也可以同步。运行期间，预览和编辑会等待。仅 Wi-Fi 选项已加入编辑器。

notes.en: Trackhop 2.1.1. New sync asks: one target or several. A multi sync has the classic editor and a card like any other: colour, label, star, menu, drag. It shows which service is syncing now and names the one that needs attention. Selecting syncs is easier: Select comes first in the menu and has its own button. TIDAL suggestions show their artists again. More services renew their access by themselves. YouTube Music: one refused song no longer stops the others.
notes.it: Trackhop 2.1.1. New sync chiede: una destinazione o più. La sync multipla ha l'editor classico e una card come le altre: colore, etichetta, stella, menu. Mostra quale servizio sta sincronizzando e quello che va controllato. Selezionare più sync è più facile: Seleziona è il primo nel menu e ha un suo pulsante. I suggerimenti di TIDAL mostrano di nuovo gli artisti. Più servizi rinnovano l'accesso da soli. YouTube Music: un brano rifiutato non ferma più gli altri.
notes.es: Trackhop 2.1.1. Nueva sync pregunta: un destino o varios. La multi tiene el editor clásico y una tarjeta como las demás: color, etiqueta, estrella, menú. Muestra qué servicio se sincroniza y cuál necesita atención. Seleccionar varias es más fácil: Seleccionar es lo primero del menú y tiene su propio botón. Las sugerencias de TIDAL vuelven a mostrar sus artistas. Más servicios renuevan el acceso solos. YouTube Music: una canción rechazada ya no detiene las demás.
notes.pt: Trackhop 2.1.1. Nova sync pergunta: um destino ou vários. A multi tem o editor clássico e um cartão como os outros: cor, rótulo, estrela, menu. Mostra qual serviço está sincronizando e qual precisa de atenção. Selecionar várias ficou mais fácil: Selecionar vem primeiro no menu e tem botão próprio, e a seleção só termina quando você a fecha. As sugestões do TIDAL voltam a mostrar os artistas. Mais serviços renovam o acesso sozinhos. YouTube Music: uma música recusada não para mais as outras.
notes.fr: Trackhop 2.1.1. Nouvelle synchro demande : une cible ou plusieurs. La multi a l'éditeur classique et une carte comme les autres : couleur, étoile, menu. Elle montre quel service se synchronise et lequel demande attention. La sélection est plus simple : Sélectionner est en tête du menu et a son bouton. Les suggestions TIDAL affichent de nouveau leurs artistes. Plus de services renouvellent leur accès seuls. YouTube Music : un titre refusé n'arrête plus les autres.
notes.de: Trackhop 2.1.1. Neuer Sync fragt: ein Ziel oder mehrere. Ein Multi-Sync hat den klassischen Editor und eine Karte wie alle: Farbe, Label, Stern, Menü. Sie zeigt, welcher Dienst gerade läuft und welcher Aufmerksamkeit braucht. Mehrere Syncs auswählen ist einfacher: Auswählen steht im Menü oben und hat eine eigene Taste. TIDAL-Vorschläge zeigen wieder ihre Künstler. Mehr Dienste erneuern den Zugang selbst. YouTube Music: Ein abgelehnter Song stoppt die anderen nicht mehr.
notes.pl: Trackhop 2.1.1. Nowa synchronizacja pyta: jeden cel czy kilka. Multi ma klasyczny edytor i kartę jak inne: kolor, etykieta, gwiazdka, menu. Pokazuje, który serwis się synchronizuje, i który wymaga uwagi. Wybieranie kilku jest prostsze: Wybierz jest pierwsze w menu i ma własny przycisk, a wybór kończy się dopiero, gdy go zamkniesz. Propozycje TIDAL znów pokazują wykonawców. Więcej serwisów samo odnawia dostęp. YouTube Music: jeden odrzucony utwór nie zatrzymuje już pozostałych.
notes.ru: Trackhop 2.1.1. Новая синхронизация спрашивает: одна цель или несколько. У мульти — обычный редактор и карточка как у всех: цвет, метка, звезда, меню. Видно, какой сервис синхронизируется сейчас и какому нужно внимание. Выбрать несколько синхронизаций проще: «Выбрать» стоит первым в меню и есть отдельная кнопка, а выбор закрывается только вами. Подсказки TIDAL снова показывают исполнителей. Больше сервисов сами обновляют доступ. YouTube Music: один отклонённый трек не останавливает остальные.

notes.en:
Fixes, released with the app's 2.1.4.

- **Deezer liked songs**: likes go in at a steady pace, and when Deezer limits them Trackhop waits a little and goes on. The songs it could not add yet are reported as "to add next run" instead of not found, and the next run adds them. An expired session or a lost connection is still an error.

Fixes, released with the app's 2.1.2.

- **TIDAL**: search and ISRC results have their artists again, so suggestions show them and matching scores are fair.
- **Sessions renewed by themselves**: Qobuz, Anghami, Gaana and Apple Music renew a refused session from the still valid web session and try again; Deezer tries once more on a refused session. A sign-in no longer clears the site's cookies when it keeps the session read from the page.
- **YouTube Music**: a song refused on add no longer stops the others; the message is plain words, never YouTube's raw answer.

Released together with the app's 2.1. Apple Music/iTunes libraries and playlist files of any size, a server that
picks up cleanly after a restart, Saved matches, concert alerts with a calendar to subscribe to, Koel, Gaana,
Apple Music's daily and city charts, rekordbox XML, WPL and ZPL; then matching across alphabets, a richer
diagnostic log and security fixes. Thanks to JPMarcelino (#66), raykai (#67) and ingoau (#68, #69).

- **Libraries and playlist files of any size** (#67): the page's form, the API and `trackhop import` write an upload to the data folder as it arrives and read it a piece at a time, so the space on the disk is the only limit. An Apple Music/iTunes library (or a rekordbox collection) lists its playlists to tick, each becoming a file; the API takes `?playlists=` and `?whole=true`. A file or an upload cut short adds nothing and is said to be incomplete.
- **Interrupted by a restart**: a sync run by hand or a long tool cut short by a restart is said at the next start, with Retry on the page, in the API and in the command line's status; it is never started again by itself. A new playlist filled half way shows in Tools with **Continue**, which adds only the tracks that are missing; *Remove duplicates* cut short puts the song back in its playlist at the next start and says which.
- **Nothing half written**: sign-ins and settings that cannot be read are kept aside (readable by their owner only) and said on every page, a failed save too; copies to the backup folder, lyrics files and the files the command line saves are written whole or not at all. An error in one turn of the minute loop, or in one sync of it, is written in the log and the scheduled syncs go on.
- **Safer syncs**: a source that lists fewer tracks than it counts for the playlist (beyond the few hidden entries services always have) is read again; still short, a sync that removes stops before writing anything and says so. A playlist made by a run whose reply was lost is found and taken, not made a second time.
- **Saved matches**: a page that lists what Trackhop remembers across all syncs (matches, songs not found, ignored), to read and to forget.
- **Concert alerts and a calendar**: alerts for tickets going on sale, presales, and dates moved or called off, for the artists and venues followed, each kind with its switch; a calendar to subscribe to (`.ics`) behind a secret address that can be renewed.
- **Matching across alphabets**: a song listed in Cyrillic, Greek, kana, Hangul, Hebrew or Arabic matches its Latin name when the artist and the length agree; an artist written with consonants alone always goes to the review.
- **rekordbox XML**: a rekordbox collection (*File › Export Collection in xml format*) is read like an Apple Music library, of any size: its playlists are offered to tick, each becomes a file. It is read only: a list of songs has no file locations for rekordbox to load.
- **WPL and ZPL**: Windows Media Player, Groove and Zune playlists are read (by their paths, or by the title, artist and album Zune writes) and written. A file of either kind that was cut short is refused, as the other XML files are.
- **Apple Music daily and city charts**: the Charts source also lists Apple's Daily Top 100 (world and countries) and the cities' Top 25, from the Apple Music API's charts call, where an Apple Music developer token is set (Settings, or `APPLE_DEVELOPER_TOKEN`); without one the list is as before.
- **Koel** (beta): your Koel server as a source and a target, on the Subsonic connector (Koel speaks OpenSubsonic): playlists read and written, favourites as liked songs. Sign in with your Koel email and the Subsonic API key from your Koel profile, not your Koel password.
- **Gaana** (unofficial, alpha): your playlists and favourite songs with the session of a browser signed in to gaana.com, read and written (create, add, remove, rename, delete), matched by ISRC where the source has one; and public Gaana playlists as a source, from their link, with no account.
- **Richer diagnostic log**: counts only, never names, tokens or keys: how many playlists a read listed against the total the service declared, how each run matched its tracks and why the others were not found, the Discover pages' sources and results, the shared playlists' events. The report for asking for help no longer names the people of a shared server.
- **Security**: the text fields of an upload form are capped all together; a name typed at sign-in that is not a user name never reaches the log.

Trackhop 2.0. Discover from your music: your Wrapped from what you really play, new releases, concerts, setlists, records and merch of your artists, alerts for the ones you follow. Shared playlists: one for a group, each on their own service. Your server from the phone. A fresh look, tablets too. Podcasts and OPML. Covers on more services. Encrypted full backup. Stars, labels and tags. Two-way syncs follow removals. No live versions in place of studio ones. YouTube Music stays signed in.

Playlist condivise: una per un gruppo, ognuno sul proprio servizio. Il tuo server dal telefono. Nuovo aspetto, anche su tablet. Podcast e OPML. Copertine su più servizi. Backup completo cifrato. Stelle, etichette e tag. Bidirezionale con rimozioni. Niente live al posto dello studio. YouTube Music resta collegato.

Estrellas, etiquetas, tags. Bidireccionales con eliminaciones. Nada de directos en vez del estudio. YouTube Music sigue conectado.

notes.zh: Trackhop 2.0。从你的音乐出发:根据你真正听的歌生成 Wrapped,你的艺人的新发行、演唱会、演出曲目、唱片与周边,关注艺人的提醒。共享歌单:一个小组共用一个歌单,每人用自己的服务。在手机上使用你的 Trackhop 服务器。全新外观,平板也适用。播客与 OPML。更多服务支持封面。加密的完整备份。星标、标签和标记。双向同步也同步删除。不再用现场版代替录音室版本。YouTube Music 保持登录。

notes.en:
Released together with the app's 2.0. Discover from your music (new releases, concerts, setlists, records and
merch, Wrapped from what you really play, followed artists), shared playlists' mailboxes, syncs handed over from
the phone, podcasts, covers on more services and an encrypted full backup; then two-way pairs, favourites and
labels, Lyrion and Mopidy, Missing on my server and more.

- **New releases**: Tools › New releases lists the new albums, EPs and singles of a playlist's artists from Deezer and MusicBrainz, and what is announced; make them a playlist on any service, or a weekly *New releases* sync that keeps every track. `GET /api/v1/releases`, `trackhop releases` and the MCP tool `find_new_releases`; a new notification event tells when a weekly New releases sync found new music.
- **Concerts**: Tools › Concerts lists the upcoming dates of a playlist's artists in a country, from Ticketmaster and MusicBrainz, with ticket-site searches for artists without dates; your own Ticketmaster key in Settings or `TICKETMASTER_API_KEY`. `GET /api/v1/concerts`, `trackhop concerts` and the MCP tool `find_concerts`.
- **Setlists**: Tools › Setlists shows what a playlist's artists played live, from setlist.fm, and saves a setlist as a File playlist to send to any service. It needs your own free setlist.fm key, in Settings or `SETLISTFM_API_KEY`. `GET /api/v1/setlists`, `trackhop setlists` and the MCP tool `find_setlists`.
- **Records and merch**: Tools › Records and merch finds a playlist's artists' CDs, vinyl and cassettes on Discogs, the official sites and shops MusicBrainz links them to, and searches on Bandcamp, Discogs, eBay and the web; plain links. With your own Discogs token (Settings), the copies for sale and the lowest price. `GET /api/v1/records`, `trackhop records` and the MCP tool `find_records`.
- **Wrapped, playlist poster and followed artists**: Tools › Wrapped makes your Wrapped from what you really played (Last.fm, ListenBrainz, your own server's play counts, Spotify, Deezer, TIDAL, YouTube Music) with its card as a PNG; Tools › Playlist poster lists the songs you play most in the cover's colours, to print; Tools › Followed artists tells your notification channels of your artists' new releases, concerts, merch and records, checked every day. Concerts also reads Spotify's tour dates where Spotify (web) is connected. In the API, the `trackhop` command and MCP.
- **Shared playlists' mailboxes**: a group sharing a playlist can meet on your server. The app makes the group's mailbox with your API token and gets the group's key, shown once; that key only reads and writes the signed items of its own group, nothing else on the server, and a new key ends the old one. `GET`/`POST /api/v1/groups`, `GET`/`DELETE /api/v1/groups/{group}`, `POST /api/v1/groups/{group}/key` and `GET`/`POST /api/v1/groups/{group}/items`.
- **Hand-over from the app**: a phone can hand a sync over to your server and bring it back. `POST /api/v1/syncs` takes an `id` of your own, which makes the call safe to repeat: sent again, it answers the sync made the first time.
- **Review choices shared with the app**: `GET`/`POST /api/v1/syncs/{sync}/decisions` give and take in the review's choices (ignored, matched by hand, kept), each with its time; for each track the newest choice wins on both sides.
- **Podcasts**: YouTube Music's followed podcasts as a source; followed podcasts exported as OPML, with their feeds looked up.
- **Playlist covers on more services**: Spotify (web), YouTube Music, TIDAL, YouTube, Jellyfin, Emby and Plex take the source's cover.
- **More of your library**: TIDAL liked tracks, Apple Music favorites and recent plays, ListenBrainz's playlists made for you.
- **Encrypted full backup**: Backup & restore › Your set-up can save the file with the sign-ins (`tokens.json`), client secrets and pasted web cookies, locked with a password (AES-256-GCM, PBKDF2 with 600,000 rounds); restoring one asks its password and whether this server replaces the other device. `POST /api/v1/config/encrypted`, `POST /api/v1/config` with the `X-Backup-Password` header, `trackhop config --encrypted` and `trackhop config import <file> --replaces-device --replace-sign-ins`. A phone's Bridge sessions are not used on a server, and the other way round.
- **Synced lyrics from your server**: Tools › Synced lyrics lists the songs of a connected Navidrome (and other Subsonic servers), Jellyfin, Emby, Plex or Lyrion server without lyrics, looks them up on LRCLIB and shows what it found before anything is written. Jellyfin takes them through its API; for Navidrome, Emby and Plex they are saved as `.lrc` (synced) or `.txt` (plain) next to the audio file, once the server's music folder is mapped to a folder here (mounted read-write on Docker). Nothing is ever replaced. Mopidy has no lyrics. `GET /api/v1/tools/nolyrics`, `POST /api/v1/tools/nolyrics/lookup` and `/save`, `trackhop nolyrics` and the MCP tool `find_songs_without_lyrics`.
- **Two-way pairs on the web page**: make a two-way pair from the page; the pair is turned on or off and deleted as one. A pair can follow removals too: a track removed on one side goes from the other, and removals held back for a check are confirmed from the page. A playlist renamed on either side updates both halves of the pair.
- **Favourites, labels and tags**: star a sync, name a colour as a label, add key/value tags; filter and search by them on the page, and in the API (filters, run a group by tag or label), the `trackhop` command and the MCP tools.
- **No more doubles from two devices**: a set-up brought in from another device keeps its scheduled syncs paused, shown as *Scheduled on* and the device's name; a playlist is read again just before it is written; a track a sync added twice is removed by the next run.
- **MusicBrainz matching for your own server**: Navidrome, Jellyfin, Emby and Plex answer with the file tagged with the source track's recording; the *MusicBrainz tags* report in Tools, the API, the CLI and MCP lists the songs without those tags.
- **Lyrion Music Server and Mopidy** (beta): playlists read, created, filled and mirrored on your own Lyrion or Mopidy server.
- **Missing on my server**: one list of the tracks your syncs to your own server could not find, by album, ticked when you get them, exported as CSV, M3U, text, JSON or a Lidarr Custom List (with a read-only list key). `GET /api/v1/wanted`, `trackhop wanted`, the MCP tool `list_missing_on_server` and the `wanted.added` webhook.
- **Quicker review**: removing a wrong match reads the target playlist only as far as needed, or not at all right after a run.
- **Diagnostics**: a report with a ready GitHub issue, secrets and names left out, which first looks for the same issue on GitHub; from the API, `trackhop diagnostics` and MCP.
- **Crowded schedules on the page**: when many syncs reach one service at once, a card proposes new times to confirm; the same through the API, CLI and MCP; a two-way pair counts once.
- **Safer notification channels**: a channel that comes with a set-up file stays off until you turn it on; saved keys stay with a channel only while its server or webhook address is the same; the ntfy topic is kept as a secret; failures and technical reports leave out webhook addresses, tokens and keys.
- **Official APIs**: Spotify apps in Development Mode find relinked tracks again; YouTube's searches are counted in their own daily allowance; Jellyfin is asked on its current routes first (the older ones as a fallback) and a playlist's order is kept there too; the Deezer texts say new developer apps can no longer be made (an existing one keeps working); Navidrome and other OpenSubsonic servers sign in with an API key; TIDAL lists your own playlists with its current filter.

TIDAL: saved albums and followed artists sync again, after TIDAL changed its API. Amazon Music: search works again. Better matching of numbered parts and remastered titles; Jellyfin and Emby also search the artist's own songs when no title is close.
notes.it: TIDAL: album salvati e artisti seguiti si sincronizzano di nuovo, dopo un cambio delle API di TIDAL. Amazon Music: la ricerca funziona di nuovo. Abbinamenti migliori per le parti numerate e i titoli rimasterizzati; Jellyfin ed Emby cercano anche tra i brani dell'artista quando nessun titolo è vicino.
notes.es: TIDAL: los álbumes guardados y los artistas seguidos vuelven a sincronizarse, tras un cambio en la API de TIDAL. Amazon Music: la búsqueda vuelve a funcionar. Mejor emparejamiento de partes numeradas y títulos remasterizados; Jellyfin y Emby también buscan entre las canciones del artista cuando ningún título se acerca.
notes.pt: TIDAL: álbuns salvos e artistas seguidos voltam a sincronizar, depois de uma mudança na API do TIDAL. Amazon Music: a busca volta a funcionar. Correspondência melhor para partes numeradas e títulos remasterizados; Jellyfin e Emby também procuram nas músicas do artista quando nenhum título chega perto.
notes.fr: TIDAL : tes albums enregistrés et tes artistes suivis se synchronisent à nouveau, après un changement de l'API de TIDAL. Amazon Music : la recherche fonctionne à nouveau. Meilleure correspondance des parties numérotées et des titres remasterisés ; Jellyfin et Emby cherchent aussi parmi les titres de l'artiste quand aucun titre n'est proche.
notes.de: TIDAL: Gespeicherte Alben und gefolgte Künstler werden wieder synchronisiert, nachdem TIDAL seine API geändert hat. Amazon Music: Die Suche funktioniert wieder. Bessere Zuordnung nummerierter Teile und remasterter Titel; Jellyfin und Emby durchsuchen auch die Songs des Künstlers, wenn kein Titel nah genug ist.
notes.pl: TIDAL: zapisane albumy i obserwowani wykonawcy znów się synchronizują po zmianie API TIDAL. Amazon Music: wyszukiwanie znów działa. Lepsze dopasowanie numerowanych części i zremasterowanych tytułów; Jellyfin i Emby przeszukują też utwory wykonawcy, gdy żaden tytuł nie jest bliski.
notes.ru: TIDAL: сохранённые альбомы и отслеживаемые исполнители снова синхронизируются после изменения API TIDAL. Amazon Music: поиск снова работает. Лучшее сопоставление пронумерованных частей и ремастированных треков; Jellyfin и Emby также ищут среди треков исполнителя, если ни одно название не подходит.
notes.tr: TIDAL: kaydedilen albümler ve takip edilen sanatçılar, TIDAL'ın API değişikliğinden sonra yeniden eşitleniyor. Amazon Music: arama yeniden çalışıyor. Numaralı bölümler ve remaster başlıklar için daha iyi eşleştirme; Jellyfin ve Emby, hiçbir başlık yakın değilse sanatçının kendi şarkılarında da arıyor.
notes.ja: TIDAL：API の変更後、保存したアルバムとフォロー中のアーティストを再び同期できるようになりました。Amazon Music：検索が再び使えるようになりました。番号付きのパートやリマスター版のタイトルの照合を改善しました。Jellyfin と Emby では、近いタイトルがない場合にアーティストの曲からも探します。
notes.ko: TIDAL: TIDAL API 변경 이후 저장한 앨범과 팔로우한 아티스트가 다시 동기화돼요. Amazon Music: 검색이 다시 작동해요. 번호가 붙은 파트와 리마스터 제목의 매칭이 좋아졌어요. Jellyfin과 Emby에서는 비슷한 제목이 없으면 아티스트의 곡에서도 찾아요.
notes.zh: TIDAL：TIDAL 更改 API 后，已保存的专辑和关注的艺人可以重新同步。Amazon Music：搜索恢复正常。改进了编号分段和重制版标题的匹配；在 Jellyfin 和 Emby 上，没有相近标题时也会在该艺人的歌曲中查找。

notes.en:
- **TIDAL saved albums and followed artists sync again**: TIDAL's API no longer has the collection paths Trackhop used (reads and writes answered "Resource not found"); they now go through its new saved-albums and followed-artists resources.
- **Better matching of numbered parts and remastered titles** (#57): a bare number after a title is its part when the other title names one ("Magnetic Fields III" is Part 3, never Part 2), another part is never matched nor proposed; more remaster forms leave the search ("Digital Remaster", "24-bit", "Remasterizado"); an album named "A / B" matches either name; Jellyfin and Emby also search the artist's own songs when no title is close.

SoundCloud stays signed in: the app now renews the SoundCloud session in the background, so it no longer expires after a few days without syncs. If it does expire, a single notification takes you straight to Accounts to sign in again.
notes.it: SoundCloud resta collegato: l'app ora rinnova la sessione di SoundCloud in background, così non scade più dopo qualche giorno senza sync. Se scade comunque, una sola notifica ti porta dritto in Account per accedere di nuovo.
notes.es: SoundCloud sigue conectado: la app ahora renueva la sesión de SoundCloud en segundo plano, así que ya no caduca tras unos días sin sincronizar. Si aun así caduca, una sola notificación te lleva directo a Cuentas para volver a iniciar sesión.
notes.pt: O SoundCloud continua conectado: o app agora renova a sessão do SoundCloud em segundo plano, então ela não expira mais depois de alguns dias sem sincronizar. Se expirar mesmo assim, uma única notificação leva você direto a Contas para entrar de novo.
notes.fr: SoundCloud reste connecté : l'app renouvelle maintenant la session SoundCloud en arrière-plan, elle n'expire donc plus après quelques jours sans synchronisation. Si elle expire quand même, une seule notification t'emmène directement dans Comptes pour te reconnecter.
notes.de: SoundCloud bleibt angemeldet: Die App erneuert die SoundCloud-Sitzung jetzt im Hintergrund, damit sie nach ein paar Tagen ohne Sync nicht mehr abläuft. Läuft sie doch ab, bringt dich eine einzige Benachrichtigung direkt zu den Konten, um dich erneut anzumelden.
notes.pl: SoundCloud pozostaje zalogowany: aplikacja odnawia teraz sesję SoundCloud w tle, więc nie wygasa już po kilku dniach bez synchronizacji. Jeśli jednak wygaśnie, jedno powiadomienie zabierze cię prosto do Kont, by zalogować się ponownie.
notes.ru: SoundCloud остаётся подключённым: приложение теперь обновляет сессию SoundCloud в фоне, и она больше не истекает после нескольких дней без синхронизации. Если всё же истечёт, одно уведомление сразу откроет «Аккаунты», чтобы войти снова.
notes.tr: SoundCloud oturumu açık kalır: uygulama artık SoundCloud oturumunu arka planda yeniliyor, böylece birkaç gün eşitleme yapılmadığında sona ermiyor. Yine de sona ererse tek bir bildirim seni yeniden giriş yapman için doğrudan Hesaplar'a götürür.
notes.ja: SoundCloud のログインが続くようになりました。アプリがバックグラウンドで SoundCloud のセッションを更新するので、数日同期しなくても切れません。それでも切れた場合は、通知が一度だけ届き、タップするとアカウント画面で再ログインできます。
notes.ko: SoundCloud 로그인이 유지돼요. 이제 앱이 백그라운드에서 SoundCloud 세션을 갱신하므로 며칠 동안 동기화하지 않아도 만료되지 않아요. 그래도 만료되면 알림이 한 번만 와서 계정 화면에서 바로 다시 로그인할 수 있어요.
notes.zh: SoundCloud 保持登录：应用现在会在后台续期 SoundCloud 会话，几天不同步也不会再过期。如果仍然过期，只会收到一条通知，点按即可直接前往账号重新登录。

notes.en: Better matching on your own servers (Jellyfin, Emby, Plex, Navidrome): titles like "Oxygene, Pt. 4" or with a subtitle are found even when the server first answers with other songs, "U.S.A" matches "USA", and tracks missed by older versions are searched again on the next sync. Different parts of a piece are still kept apart.
notes.it: Abbinamenti migliori sui tuoi server (Jellyfin, Emby, Plex, Navidrome): titoli come "Oxygene, Pt. 4" o con un sottotitolo vengono trovati anche quando il server risponde prima con altri brani, "U.S.A" corrisponde a "USA" e i brani non trovati dalle versioni precedenti vengono cercati di nuovo alla prossima sync. Le parti diverse di un brano restano distinte.
notes.es: Mejor emparejamiento en tus propios servidores (Jellyfin, Emby, Plex, Navidrome): títulos como "Oxygene, Pt. 4" o con subtítulo se encuentran aunque el servidor responda primero con otras canciones, "U.S.A" coincide con "USA" y las pistas que versiones anteriores no encontraron se buscan de nuevo en la próxima sincronización. Las distintas partes de una obra siguen separadas.
notes.pt: Correspondência melhor nos seus próprios servidores (Jellyfin, Emby, Plex, Navidrome): títulos como "Oxygene, Pt. 4" ou com subtítulo são encontrados mesmo quando o servidor responde primeiro com outras músicas, "U.S.A" corresponde a "USA" e faixas não encontradas por versões anteriores são buscadas de novo na próxima sincronização. Partes diferentes de uma obra continuam separadas.
notes.fr: Meilleure correspondance sur tes propres serveurs (Jellyfin, Emby, Plex, Navidrome) : les titres comme « Oxygene, Pt. 4 » ou avec un sous-titre sont trouvés même quand le serveur répond d'abord avec d'autres morceaux, « U.S.A » correspond à « USA », et les titres non trouvés par les anciennes versions sont recherchés à nouveau à la prochaine synchro. Les différentes parties d'une œuvre restent séparées.
notes.de: Besseres Zuordnen auf deinen eigenen Servern (Jellyfin, Emby, Plex, Navidrome): Titel wie „Oxygene, Pt. 4" oder mit Untertitel werden gefunden, auch wenn der Server zuerst andere Songs liefert, „U.S.A" passt zu „USA", und von älteren Versionen nicht gefundene Titel werden beim nächsten Sync erneut gesucht. Verschiedene Teile eines Stücks bleiben getrennt.
notes.pl: Lepsze dopasowanie na twoich serwerach (Jellyfin, Emby, Plex, Navidrome): tytuły jak „Oxygene, Pt. 4" lub z podtytułem są znajdowane, nawet gdy serwer najpierw zwraca inne utwory, „U.S.A" pasuje do „USA", a utwory nieznalezione przez starsze wersje są szukane ponownie przy następnej synchronizacji. Różne części utworu pozostają rozdzielone.
notes.ru: Лучшее сопоставление на ваших серверах (Jellyfin, Emby, Plex, Navidrome): названия вроде «Oxygene, Pt. 4» или с подзаголовком находятся, даже если сервер сначала отвечает другими треками, «U.S.A» совпадает с «USA», а треки, не найденные прежними версиями, ищутся снова при следующей синхронизации. Разные части произведения не смешиваются.
notes.tr: Kendi sunucularında daha iyi eşleştirme (Jellyfin, Emby, Plex, Navidrome): "Oxygene, Pt. 4" gibi ya da alt başlıklı adlar, sunucu önce başka şarkılar döndürse bile bulunur, "U.S.A" "USA" ile eşleşir ve eski sürümlerin bulamadığı parçalar bir sonraki senkronizasyonda yeniden aranır. Bir eserin farklı bölümleri ayrı kalır.
notes.ja: 自分のサーバー（Jellyfin、Emby、Plex、Navidrome）での照合を改善：「Oxygene, Pt. 4」やサブタイトル付きの曲名も、サーバーが先に別の曲を返しても見つかります。「U.S.A」は「USA」と一致し、以前のバージョンで見つからなかった曲は次の同期で再検索されます。作品の別パートは区別されたままです。
notes.ko: 내 서버(Jellyfin, Emby, Plex, Navidrome)에서 매칭 개선: "Oxygene, Pt. 4"처럼 파트 번호나 부제가 있는 제목도 서버가 다른 곡을 먼저 돌려줘도 찾아요. "U.S.A"는 "USA"와 일치하고, 이전 버전에서 못 찾은 곡은 다음 동기화 때 다시 검색해요. 한 작품의 다른 파트는 계속 구분돼요.
notes.zh: 改进自建服务器（Jellyfin、Emby、Plex、Navidrome）上的匹配：即使服务器先返回其他歌曲，"Oxygene, Pt. 4" 这类或带副标题的曲名也能找到；"U.S.A" 与 "USA" 匹配；旧版本没找到的曲目会在下次同步时重新搜索。同一作品的不同部分仍会分开。

notes.en: - **Better matching on your own media servers** (#57): Jellyfin, Emby, Plex and Navidrome/Subsonic also search the bare title (without "Pt. 4", subtitles or "- Remastered", with and without accents) when the first answers bring only other songs; dotted initials are one word ("U.S.A" is "USA"); tracks missed before an update to matching are searched again on the next run instead of staying "not found" for a week. Different parts of a piece are still never matched to each other.

New card styles; tap the status dot for a bubble. A warning when many syncs hit one service at once, with a one-tap spread (#56). Qobuz retries refused reads (#56). "Pt. 4" and "Part IV" now match (#57). Files your way (#49): artist and album from names, folders or your patterns. Last.fm loved tracks as a target (#51). Anghami signs in with Google (#53). YouTube Music brand channels (#41). Rate and share Trackhop. GitHub build: a notification for new versions.
notes.it: Nuovi stili delle card; tocca il pallino dello stato per un fumetto. Avviso quando tante sync colpiscono un servizio insieme, con distribuzione in un tocco (#56). Qobuz riprova le letture rifiutate (#56). "Pt. 4" e "Part IV" ora coincidono (#57). File a modo tuo (#49). Brani preferiti di Last.fm come destinazione (#51). Anghami accede con Google (#53). Canali brand di YouTube Music (#41). Valuta e condividi Trackhop. Build GitHub: notifica delle nuove versioni.
notes.es: Nuevos estilos de tarjeta; toca el punto de estado para ver un globo. Aviso cuando muchas sincronizaciones llegan a un servicio a la vez, con reparto en un toque (#56). Qobuz reintenta lecturas rechazadas (#56). "Pt. 4" y "Part IV" ya coinciden (#57). Archivos a tu manera (#49). Favoritas de Last.fm como destino (#51). Anghami con Google (#53). Qobuz tenta de novo leituras recusadas (#56). "Pt. 4" e "Part IV" agora coincidem (#57). Arquivos do seu jeito (#49). Favoritas do Last.fm como destino (#51). Anghami com Google (#53). Qobuz réessaie les lectures refusées (#56). « Pt. 4 » et « Part IV » correspondent (#57). Fichiers à votre façon (#49). Favoris Last.fm comme destination (#51). Anghami avec Google (#53).
